title: Odds of a surgical patient's death by patients per nurse, relative to four
description: Bar chart of the odds of death within 30 days of admission for a surgical patient, relative to a nurse caring for four patients, compounding the odds ratio of 1.07 for each additional patient per nurse found by Aiken and colleagues in 168 Pennsylvania hospitals (JAMA, 2002): 1.00 at four patients, 1.07 at five, 1.14 at six, 1.23 at seven and 1.31 at eight. The compounding is kloom's arithmetic, not the paper's table.
heading: ODDS OF DEATH, RELATIVE TO 4 PATIENTS A NURSE
